New listing (published July 23, 2026)

On Saturday, August 1, 2026 (Reiwa 8), the newly renovated Hanno Riverbed Stage Plaza will host the Hanno Summer Solstice Festival—Forest, Water, and Sun Beer Garden. Under bonfires symbolizing the Nordic summer solstice, you can enjoy live music from the TUMUZI band performing violin, guitar, and percussion. Food trucks scheduled to appear include: COTORIDO (crepes), RUBBER SOUL (candy apples and chocolate-banana treats), Ranmaru Sales (grilled chicken), Jutty (curry), and CARVAAN (craft beer and Mediterranean cuisine).
